description: This file implements a StateHandler class for managing lifecycle states in a plugin framework, including state transitions, validation, event notifications, and state creation.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class managing lifecycle state transitions, validation, and event notifications within a plugin framework.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application state to a new lifecycle state, handling creation, validation, and cleanup.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object based on the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition from start to target state is valid, using recursion to verify possible paths.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the possible state transitions and state strings mappings.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Handles a request to change the application state, including path calculation, transition, and event notification.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event with details about the transition.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Calculates the sequence of states to transition from current to target state.
